name: Weight of moving object
description: Mass of an object that moves or can move

name: Weight of stationary object
description: Mass of an object fixed in place

name: Length of moving object
description: A linear dimension of a moving object

name: Length of stationary object
description: A linear dimension of a stationary object

name: Area of moving object
description: Surface/area occupied by a moving object

name: Area of stationary object
description: Surface/area occupied by a stationary object

name: Volume of moving object
description: Space occupied by a moving object

name: Volume of stationary object
description: Space occupied by a stationary object

name: Shape
description: Outline/contours/form of a system

name: Amount of substance
description: Quantity of material/parts used or present

name: Amount of information
description: Quantity of data, signal, or knowledge the system holds or conveys

name: Duration of action of moving object
description: Service life / how long a moving object functions

name: Duration of action of stationary object
description: Service life / how long a stationary object functions

name: Speed
description: Velocity of an object or process; rate of change

name: Force/Torque
description: Force or rotational force intended to change an object's condition

name: Energy used by moving object
description: Energy consumed to perform work while moving

name: Energy used by stationary object
description: Energy consumed to perform work while stationary

name: Power
description: Rate of energy use (energy per unit time)

name: Stress/Pressure
description: Force per unit area

name: Strength
description: Resistance to breaking, deforming, or failing under force

name: Stability
description: Wholeness/robustness of a system's composition and behavior over time

name: Temperature
description: Thermal state of an object or system

name: Illumination intensity
description: Light output, luminous flux, illumination level

name: Function efficiency
description: How effectively the system converts input into intended output

name: Loss of substance
description: Material wasted, leaked, or degraded

name: Loss of time
description: Time wasted; efficiency in the temporal sense

name: Loss of energy
description: Energy wasted without contributing useful work

name: Loss of information
description: Data, signal, or knowledge lost or degraded

name: Noise
description: Unwanted acoustic (or by extension, signal) disturbance produced

name: Harmful emissions
description: Unwanted substances or radiation released into the environment

name: Other harmful effects generated by object
description: Negative effects (not emissions/noise) the system itself produces

name: Adaptability/versatility
description: Ability to respond positively to external changes, or serve multiple functions

name: Compatibility/connectability
description: Ease of interfacing/integrating with other systems or components

name: Usability/trainability
description: Ease of learning to use the system correctly

name: Reliability/robustness
description: Ability to perform intended function consistently over time/conditions

name: Repairability
description: Ease of fixing faults; time/quality/cost of repair

name: Security
description: Resistance to unauthorized access, tampering, or intentional harm

name: Safety/vulnerability
description: Exposure to accidental harm; how safe the system is to be around

name: Appearance & aesthetics
description: Visual/sensory appeal of the system

name: Other harmful effect on system
description: Negative effects something external inflicts on the system

name: Manufacturability
description: Ease/cost of producing the object

name: Manufacturing precision/uniformity
description: How closely a manufactured part matches its specification, batch to batch

name: Automation
description: Extent a system performs its function without human intervention

name: Productivity
description: Output (functions or objects) per unit time

name: Complexity of system
description: Number and diversity of elements and their interrelations

name: Complexity of control
description: Difficulty of measuring/monitoring/controlling a system

name: Ability to detect/measure
description: How easily a property or state of the system can be observed

name: Measurement precision
description: Closeness of a measured value to the true value
